title: RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 Is BIGGER Than You Think
author: Kodeations
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 Is Bigger Than You Think! RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 launches September 15th with the Scorned Wilderness Raid, Kuldra, Runite gear, major combat changes, console releases, crossplay, and much more.

In this video, I break down everything Jagex has officially confirmed for Dragonwilds 1.0, including the new endgame progression, Kuldra rewards, Rune Armour, Black Dragonhide, Ancestral Robes, the Special Attack system, Wands, Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, pricing, and what comes after 1.0.

Whether you’re jumping into Dragonwilds for the first time or returning for launch, here’s what you need to know before September 15th.

⚔️ More RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, news, updates, and 1.0 coverage coming soon.
